records.deidentified_narrative: unit1 was slowly driving through the heb parking lot according to both unit1 driver and ped. ped and her husband were leaving heb as they had just finished grocery shopping. ped just finished putting away her grocery cart in the cart corral. this is when, according to ped, ped remembers turning around and colliding with unit1 in which ped fell to the ground. according to ped, she blacked out for a few seconds after falling to [roadway] and hitting her face/head. unit1 driver came out of his vehicle to check on ped and also provided his card so that ped could contact unit1 driver. ems was dispatched to the scene but pd was never dispatched to the scene. (fire incident #: 2025-0106898-safd) according to ped, she was not transported by ems/ambulance but instead [roadway] ped to a methodist urgent care. from the urgent care, [medical facility] where ped was advised by a physician that she had a broken nose and a brain bleed according to ped. while taking this report, i observed ped to have injuries to her nose and the right side of her face to include the right orbital area. i advised tid detective c. pawelek #2131 of the incident as well as patrol supervisor sgt. j. guerrero #3035. i then drove to unit1 driver's residence which was near by to get his side of story. upon arrival i spoke with unit1 driver who stated that he was at the heb parking lot driving slowly when he heard a bump emit from the passenger side door. i observed what appeared to be scratch marks on the right side of the vehicle near the side view mirror. i did not observed any other damage to the vehicle. when unit1 driver got out to check what had happened, he saw ped laying on the ground with blood on her head. ped's face was wiped and unit1 driver helped walk ped to her vehicle to sit down. unit1 driver left his card with ped and her husband to call unit1 driver. both parties were given the [case id]. there are no known neutral witnesses at this time. this report was made two days after the incident. dme available.
